purpose: Independent service review for São José do Rio Preto official cadastral and parcel-oriented map sources.
assessment: The municipal public SIG is evidenced and its Quadras layer returned one block polygon at the exact WUP point. No individual parcel layer or safe parcel identity was verified, so no GeoJSON sample is retained. Runtime readiness remains held pending serial review.
registryAssessment: The official São Paulo service catalog names the Prefeitura de São José do Rio Preto / Serviço Municipal da Fazenda as responsible for the public Mapa Digital. The separate measures-and-confrontations service references Cadastro Imobiliário (IPTU) and documentary requirements; it is not anonymous parcel geometry access. This is municipal map/cadastral-service evidence, not title or ownership evidence.
